list.bullet: Loop over all elements for %nest% events
Find closest livingroom temperature before and after

Temperature(s) at Nest on/off points:
~ΔT~ = ΔT1 - ΔT0
~Δt~ = Δt1 - Δt0
~x~ = tnest - t0
~T~nest = ((x / Δt) * ΔT) + ΔT0 *°C*

Rate between Nest on/off points:
~ΔT~ = Toff - Ton
~Δt~ = toff - ton
~rate~ = ΔT / Δt *°C / second*
